Poisoned.note: On the player who was the Demon and has just become the new Snake Charmer after the swap.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: The old Demon stays poisoned after the swap, whatever happens next.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The old Demon, now the Snake Charmer, is poisoned.

full.text: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens and give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep, wake the old Demon, show the *YOU ARE* & Snake Charmer tokens and give a thumbs up. Mark the new Snake Charmer *POISONED*.
full.reason: Says the old Demon, now the Snake Charmer, gets the Poisoned token.
